question: A 64-year-old male farmer, ex-smoker (5 years old), COPD and rheumatoid arthritis in corticosteroid treatment. Consultation in the emergency room due to intense headache of 2 days of evolution with buccal commissure deviation. As an antecedent, he recounts that after a month of flu, cough persists, purulent expectoration and occasionally haemoptica, fever, anorexia, asthenia and weight loss. Upon arrival, there is a fever of 38.2ºC, multiple cutaneous abscesses in the hands, back and buttocks (some with fistulous trajectories) and right central facial paralysis, apical infiltrates with small pleural effusion associated with the chest x-ray and leukocytosis with neutrophilia. .
